mission_01: Well done! You have implemented Logic Neural Networks that embed symbolic logic operations into differentiable neural architectures. Your AND, OR, and NOT neurons use continuous sigmoid relaxations of boolean operations, enabling gradient-based optimization while preserving logical semantics. By composing these neurons into layers, you can build networks that represent arbitrary logical formulas. This approach forms the foundation of neuro-symbolic AI: combining the learning capability of neural networks with the reasoning power and interpretability of symbolic logic. The key insight is that logical operations can be parameterized and learned through backpropagation.
